versions.version: Span-based parsing and formatting: IParsable, ISpanParsable, ISpanFormattable and IUtf8SpanFormattable are implemented, Parse and TryFormat are added, and parsing now accepts the exponent notation (1e3m). Parsing, formatting into a caller buffer, conversion, comparison and arithmetic allocate nothing. New ToString(format) overload. Generic math operator interfaces (IAdditionOperators and friends). New UnitEnumValidator reports what is wrong with a unit enumeration instead of throwing on first use; a misdeclared enumeration is also rejected with an actionable message. New opt-in MeasurementJsonConverter writes a measurement as a plain string. New MeasurementMath helpers: Power from torque and rotational speed, Force, Density, Weight, Acceleration, Min, Max, Clamp, Round. New Sum and Average over sequences of measurements. The assembly is now marked trimmable. BREAKING: DecimalMeasurement.ZERO is now typed DecimalMeasurement rather than Measurement. BREAKING: DensityUnit.OuncesPerCubicFeet is obsolete, replaced by OuncesPerCubicInch, which is what its unit name and its factor always were; parsing oz/in3 now yields OuncesPerCubicInch.
Netstandard support dropped. Performance improvements. Update dependencies. New units for weight, volume, energy, velocity. New measurements: rotational speed, torque
Fix comparison of very small values. Update dependencies, minor changes.
Add troy oz, metric, uk and us tonne, typographical points and picas. Make some math methods extensions. Add new method to construct value (unit.New(value)). Add conversion from and to tuples.

project.description: Measurements math, manipulations and unit conversion library
